regions.today: Mostly cloudy at first today, Wednesday, with the best of any early sunshine in the south. Sunny spells will gradually increase this afternoon and evening. Highest temperatures of 20 to 23 degrees, in light, occasionally moderate, northerly breezes.
regions.tonight: Dry for most with clear spells at first tonight. Cloudier conditions will gradually spread from the north overnight. Lowest temperatures of 9 to 13 degrees in light northerly or variable breezes.
regions.tomorrow: A mix of cloud and sunny spells to begin tomorrow, Thursday. Sunny spells will develop more widely as the day goes on. Highest temperatures of 20 to 24 degrees in light, occasionally moderate, northerly breezes.
regions.solar_uv: Mostly high today; Moderate to high tomorrow.
